title: capy-theme Theme.settings
description: Every override a theme makes on top of its light and dark base themes. Each phase adds its own keys here (colours, fonts, shape and so on). Keys not listed are rejected.

site_name.description: The site's name, shown in headers and used as the logo's fallback.

tagline.description: A short line describing the site.

logo_alt.description: Alt text for the main logo. Falls back to the site name.

default_mode.description: The colour mode pages use: "auto" follows the visitor's device, "light" or "dark" forces one. Default "auto".

visitors_can_switch.description: Whether visitors can choose light, dark or auto with {% theme_mode_toggle %}. Default true.
